$comment: Standard-legal sets per Hearthstone year. Copied from python-hearthstone (hearthstone/utils/__init__.py: STANDARD_SETS + ZODIAC_ROTATION_DATES, v9.22.0, 2026-10-13) and validated against it by tools/check_format_rotation.py in CI. Set names are the CardSet enum names used by HearthstoneJSON. Sets that rotate at the next rotation are derived: sets present in both the current and the previous year, minus 'always_standard'.

next_rotation.note: Not announced. Blizzard rotates with the first expansion of the year, late March or early April. Set 'date' when the patch date is known; until then the estimate is shown with an 'estimated' label.
